Problem Statement:
Given a string containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', and ']', determine whether the parentheses are balanced using a Stack.
A string is balanced if:
Every opening bracket has a corresponding closing bracket.
Brackets are closed in the correct order.
Input Description
A single string containing brackets.
Output Description
Print Balanced if the brackets are valid, otherwise print Not Balanced.
Sample Input
{[()]}
Sample Output
Balanced
